title: chunked: avoid blocking composefs fork
body:
storeMissingFiles closes destination files asynchronously and reported the results through a bounded channel.  Once that channel was full, the closer blocked while queued destination files were still open and held syscall.ForkLock.RLock().  A concurrent composefs generation then blocked on ForkLock.Lock() before forking mkcomposefs, while the chunked
workers could no longer acquire ForkLock.RLock() to make progress.

Tentative fix for: https://github.com/podman-container-tools/container-libs/issues/1178
